matter_reference.name: Matter Gates / original mechanisms
matter_reference.description: Original source geometry and masses: falling crates, tyre, sandbag balance and counterweight. Inputs release bodies; Jolt contacts determine the result.
interactions: Carry loose parts with right-click or XR grip; attached beams stay pinned.
Drop the mover or press RELEASE to start a physical take.
RESET releases held parts and restores the authored arrangement.

threshold_again.name: Threshold / again
threshold_again.description: One curvature changes return into drift or escape. Repeat the same small release and compare the measured time.
interactions: X cycles the three original source settings.
RELEASE starts a native physical take.
REPEAT starts the same setting again; the last three observations remain.
RESET clears the current take and keeps the comparison.
threshold_again.qfep_connection: The same Boolean result can hide different physical margins, delays and failures; the witness records what the body actually did.

threshold_almost.name: Threshold / almost
threshold_almost.description: Change release height by one millimetre, release the ball and watch its actual maximum rise against the lip.
interactions: X cycles the three original source settings.
RELEASE starts a native physical take.
REPEAT starts the same setting again; the last three observations remain.
Minus/plus one millimetre changes the real release centre.
threshold_almost.qfep_connection: The same Boolean result can hide different physical margins, delays and failures; the witness records what the body actually did.

threshold_just.name: Threshold / just
threshold_just.description: Add one physical grain, wait for the needle, then add another. The balance decides which grain tips it.
interactions: X cycles the three original source settings.
RELEASE starts a native physical take.
+1 GRAIN adds one settled grain; AUTO selects source feeding.
RESET clears the current take and keeps the comparison.
threshold_just.qfep_connection: The same Boolean result can hide different physical margins, delays and failures; the witness records what the body actually did.

source_gravity_knitter.name: Gravity Knitter
source_gravity_knitter.description: Source-faithful Matter and Logic port. Original geometry and configurations; native controls and physical evidence are recorded in the port review.
interactions: Eight rule-bit switches address patterns 111 through 000.
RULE selects presets; SEED selects single/random/blank; EDGE selects blank/wrap boundaries.
RUN pauses/resumes; STEP makes one stitch; COMPUTE is explicit mathematical completion; CLEAR resets.
